neighbours.label: a function word inside a fixed quantity or degree phrase, such as 'after all the' or 'more than doubled'
fire: The square felt empty after all the market stalls had been taken down.
The new policy more than doubled the number of people using the buses.
The house was quiet after all the guests had driven home.
Sales of the book more than tripled after the film came out.
The field looked bare after all the sheep were moved to the hills.
The repair more than halved the cost of heating the school.
The kitchen was a mess after all the children had baked cakes.
Last winter the storm more than doubled the price of firewood.
quiet: The square felt empty when the market stalls had been taken down.
The new policy greatly raised the number of people using the buses.
The house was quiet once the guests had driven home.
Sales of the book rose sharply after the film came out.
The field looked bare when the sheep were moved to the hills.
The repair cut the cost of heating the school.
The kitchen was a mess when the children had baked cakes.
Last winter the storm pushed up the price of firewood.
